import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_basic_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape[1:], dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF for input and output tiles
    sbuf_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=(128, 512), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    psum_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=(128, 512), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Copy lhsT to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_tile, src=lhsT)
    # Copy rhs to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_tile[0:128, 0:512], src=rhs)
    
    # Perform matrix multiplication
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum_tile, stationary=sbuf_tile, moving=sbuf_tile[0:128, 0:512])
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_tile, src=psum_tile)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to shared HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_tile)
    return out

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_basic_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF for input tiles
    lhsT_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape, dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    rhs_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    psum_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    # Allocate separate SBUF for result tile
    res_tile = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=lhsT_tile, src=lhsT)
    # Copy rhs to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=rhs_tile, src=rhs)
    
    # Perform matrix multiplication
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum_tile, stationary=lhsT_tile, moving=rhs_tile)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to result SBUF
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=res_tile, src=psum_tile)
    
    # Copy result from result SBUF to shared HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=res_tile)
    return out
